_doc: Single source of truth for the one-click run. Fixed before any run; the orchestrator never changes it.

B12.metric: dev macro-F1 (mean of val_ar, val_gs) at the early-stopping epoch
B12.why: GPU non-determinism and library versions; 0.5 point = ~1/4 of the seed sd of B12 on the test chain

B11.metric: best dev macro-F1 over the 3 epochs (finetune.py stdout)
B11.why: full fine-tuning of a 560M-parameter encoder is less deterministic than heads on cached features

P0_vs_V0.why: new Setting-A implementation with default values must reproduce the original trainer; else Setting A variants are not run

FT0_vs_B11.why: re-implemented B11 recipe (Setting B reference) must match original B11 dev scores of this run; else Setting B is not run

selection_rule.score: mean over seeds of dev macro-F1 = mean(val_ar, val_gs) at the early-stopping epoch
selection_rule.never_uses: test sets S0-S6, S5AR, S6AR, S6SYN

verdict_rule.test: paired bootstrap (diafuse_eval.paired_boot_p, 1000 class-stratified resamples, seed-averaged) one-sided, Holm over the 7 stages S0-S6
verdict_rule.stage_win: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND mean difference > larger seed sd (decision rule of the paper)
verdict_rule.OUTPERFORMS: stage wins on >= 4 of 7 stages and no stage where B11 wins under the same rule

table5._doc: explicit mapping of the paper's Table 5 - never derived from column order
